name: Ellen Dorrit Petersen
bio: Ellen Dorrit Petersen is a Norwegian actress.

credits.title: Fjord
credits.overview: Following the deaths of Mihai's parents, Mihai and Lisbet Gheorghiu leave their life behind in Romania and move with their children to a remote village in Norway, hoping to rebuild their lives near Lisbet's family. There, they grow close to their neighbors, the Halbergs, whose warmth gives them hope for a fresh start.

credits.title: The Fishing Place
credits.overview: A World War 2 drama that follows Anna who is captured by the Nazis and is released from captivity in exchange for taking on a mission: She will work for a German priest, to find out if he is involved in the Norwegian resistance movement.

credits.title: Armand
credits.overview: Armand, a 6-year-old boy, is accused of crossing boundaries against his best friend at elementary school. credits.title: Longing for Today
credits.overview: A young girl tries to find her own way through life in the ruins after a war that has left everything desolate.

credits.title: Leave
credits.overview: A young woman tries to find her origins after having been abandoned as an infant at a cemetery wrapped in a cloth with satanic symbols, but as she gets closer to answers a malevolent spirit is telling her to leave.

credits.title: Possession
credits.overview: A priest has been tasked with deciding the location of a new church for the local mining company, which reveals itself to be on top of an old Sami burial ground. After removing the remains, the dead come alive and haunt the settlers.

credits.title: Battle: Freestyle
credits.overview: Amalie and Mikael lead their street dance team to the finals in France but tough competition and personal distractions threaten to ruin their dreams.

credits.title: Tre nøtter til Askepott: Bakomfilm
credits.overview: The actors, director and producers behind the film Three Nuts for Cinderella take us on an adventurous journey behind the camera during the remake of the Czech classic.

credits.title: Three Wishes for Cinderella
credits.overview: Cinderella, a resourceful and independent young girl, is a servant in her stepmother's house and confides in her closest friend the owl. When she comes across three magical acorns, she's granted a single wish for each one of them.

credits.title: Frydenlund Hair Parlour
credits.overview: When 17-year-old Anna Lorentz returns to Narvik in 1940 with her older sisters and brother, they find their town destroyed. They recover the family home, and survive the years that follow by running a hair salon. All this time, Anna nurtures her own dream.

credits.title: The Innocents
credits.overview: Four children become friends during the summer holidays, and out of sight of the adults they discover they have hidden powers. While exploring their newfound abilities in the nearby forests and playgrounds, their innocent play takes a dark turn and strange things begin to happen.

credits.title: Darkness
credits.overview: Local citizens are gathered at the dock of a small fishing village. Hitler has decided that they shall all be forcefully evacuated. A girl witnesses and experiences a catastrophe again.

credits.title: Another Happy Christmas
credits.overview: When the Eide family is gathered to celebrate Christmas together for the first time in years, it doesn't take long for old secrets to surface.

credits.title: Fishlove
credits.overview: Daniel, a biologist studying the disappearance of fish, is haunted by paternity. It is by looking for a woman who could be the mother of his children that he will come across a strange fish and discover what he really lacks: love.

credits.title: Ella
credits.overview: A film about a mother's unbreakable love for her daughter. Ella only wants' to give her daughter Sara a hug.

credits.title: Thelma
credits.overview: A college student starts to experience extreme seizures. She soon learns that the violent episodes are a symptom of inexplicable abilities.

credits.title: Handle with Care
credits.overview: Kjetil, an offshore worker, is left with his six-year-old adopted son after his wife dies. To find out more about the boy's background Kjetil decides to bring the boy back to Colombia.

credits.title: Shelley
credits.overview: Louise and Kasper want to become parents, but Louise cannot have children. She seals a pact with her Romanian maid, Elena, to bear her child, but things don't turn out quite as planned...

credits.title: Dark Woods II
credits.overview: An old sanatorium is deteriorating in an isolated forest in the mountains. Five contract workers have taken on the task of tracking the huge building for hazardous waste before it's demolished. They realize that the job is more than a search for asbestos and mercury when they encounter the building's frightening past.

credits.title: Blind
credits.overview: Having recently lost her sight, Ingrid retreats to the safety of her home—a place where she can feel in control, alone with her husband and her thoughts. credits.title: Into the Dark
credits.overview: An eight-year-old boy is hit by a car, and a deep rift develops between the two neighbouring couples involved, which will prove hard to repair.

credits.title: The Mountain
credits.overview: This is the story of Nora and Solveig, a grief-stricken couple on a hike through the mountain range where they had a traumatic experience two years prior. credits.overview: PAX is a grand-scale drama. An intimate and powerful romantic film about seven people's encounter with themselves as life forces them into the raging storm. They all have someone waiting. PAX, the Latin word for peace, is also flight terminology for flight passengers. When flying in an airplane we are all "pax".

credits.title: Troubled Water
credits.overview: A man with a troubled past is released on parole. He finds work as a church organist and develops a rewarding relationship with a priest and her young son. However, his past soon catches up with him.
